instructions: A Task stores shared context and immutable parent revisions, not a workflow. Call agentharness_task_connect only in the Codex or editor session that should join. Keep the returned bindingId in that conversation and never reuse it in another session. These tools return stored Task context, not a live summary computed for the recipient. contextDelta is the full stored view, not an incremental delta. Reads do not revalidate current peer contribution grants or automatically filter expired, withdrawn, revoked, or superseded observations from stored history. No stage, evidence, approval, or completion actions exist.

tools.name: agentharness_task_list
tools.title: List AgentHarness Tasks
tools.description: List bounded shared-context Tasks in the emergence collaboration center.

tools.name: agentharness_task_get
tools.title: Get one AgentHarness Task
tools.description: Read one stored Task record and its immutable parent-revision references; this is not a live recipient-specific summary.

tools.name: agentharness_task_fork
tools.title: Fork an AgentHarness Task
tools.description: Create a new Task from one immutable parent context revision.

tools.name: agentharness_task_merge
tools.title: Merge AgentHarness Tasks
tools.description: Create a new Task that combines explicit context from two or more parent revisions.

tools.name: agentharness_task_connect
tools.title: Connect this Agent session to an AgentHarness Task
tools.description: Bind only this conversation to one Task and return its stored context and immutable parent-revision history.

tools.name: agentharness_task_disconnect
tools.title: Disconnect this Agent session from AgentHarness
tools.description: Clear one conversation binding without affecting other Codex or editor sessions.

tools.name: agentharness_task_context_publish
tools.title: Publish explicit Task context
tools.description: Publish text or an artifact reference from the connected Agent session for later Fork/Merge inheritance.

tools.name: agentharness_task_status
tools.title: Read this Agent session connection
tools.description: Return one explicit session binding and its stored Task context, and record the returned revision.

resourceTemplates.name: agentharness-task-context
resourceTemplates.title: AgentHarness stored Task context
resourceTemplates.description: Stored Task context and immutable parent-revision history; expired, withdrawn, revoked, or superseded observations may remain.
